title: SoundWave Air ANC True Wireless Earbuds
description: Premium active noise cancelling wireless earbuds featuring low-latency gaming mode, 32-hour playback, and immersive deep bass drivers.
reviews: Outstanding ANC performance for under 3000 rupees. Battery easily lasts all day.
Crisp audio and microphone quality during zoom calls is very clear.

qna.question: Does it support fast charging?
qna.answer: Yes, 10 minutes of Type-C charging gives 2 hours of music playback.

qna.question: Is it compatible with iPhone and Android?
qna.answer: Yes, works seamlessly with all Bluetooth-enabled devices.

title: BoltAudio BassBuds Pro Wireless Earbuds
description: Ergonomic ultra-lightweight earbuds with 13mm dynamic titanium drivers for punchy bass and environmental noise cancellation for calls.
reviews: Great value for money. Very punchy bass and comfortable in ears.
Decent battery life and quick pairing.

qna.question: Can I use single earbud independently?
qna.answer: Yes, both earbuds have independent mono mode support.

title: SonicBlast Ultra TWS Earbuds with Quad Mic
description: Studio-grade true wireless earbuds equipped with quad-mic ENC for crystal-clear calls, wireless charging case, and IPX6 splash resistance.
reviews: Perfect fit right under the 3000 rupees budget. Build quality feels very premium.
The quad mic setup eliminates street noise effectively during commutes.

qna.question: Does the case support wireless charging?
qna.answer: Yes, it supports Qi wireless charging pads and Type-C cables.

title: ScammyBeats Clone Wireless Earphones
description: Cheap plastic wireless earphones claiming studio sound. Unverified warranty and poor quality control.
reviews: Stopped working after 3 days. Seller never responded.

title: AuraPods Studio Wireless Earbuds High-End
description: Audiophile grade earbuds featuring LDAC high-resolution audio decoding, hybrid 42dB ANC, and multipoint device switching.
reviews: Sound quality is unmatched, though above the 3k price point.
The noise cancellation is on par with flagships.

qna.question: Does it support LDAC codec?
qna.answer: Yes, Hi-Res wireless audio with LDAC is supported on compatible Android phones.

title: PulseFit Active Smartwatch with AMOLED Display
description: Sleek fitness smartwatch with always-on AMOLED touchscreen, 120+ sports modes, and Bluetooth voice calling.
reviews: Display is super bright in sunlight. Battery lasts 8-9 days on single charge.

qna.question: Can I receive phone calls on the watch?
qna.answer: Yes, it has built-in microphone and HD speaker for Bluetooth calls.

title: BoomVibe Portable Waterproof Bluetooth Speaker
description: Rugged outdoor Bluetooth speaker delivering 360-degree room-filling sound with dual passive radiators and RGB party lights.
reviews: Took it on a camping trip in the rain, performed flawlessly. Surprising amount of bass.

qna.question: Can two speakers be paired together for stereo?
qna.answer: Yes, TWS dual pairing is supported.

title: KeyMaster Mech RGB Mechanical Keyboard
description: Hot-swappable mechanical gaming keyboard with factory lubed switches, sound dampening foam, and customizable RGB backlighting.
reviews: The linear switches feel butter-smooth out of the box.

qna.question: Is keycap puller included?
qna.answer: Yes, both keycap and switch puller are included in the box.

title: VoltFast 65W GaN Fast Charger Triple Port
description: Ultra-compact GaN charger capable of powering laptops, tablets, and smartphones simultaneously with smart temperature monitoring.
reviews: Charges my laptop and phone simultaneously without heating up at all.

qna.question: Can it fast charge MacBook Air?
qna.answer: Yes, delivers full 65W speed via USB-C port 1.

title: GlidePro Ergonomic Wireless Mouse
description: Natural handshake posture vertical mouse designed to alleviate wrist strain during prolonged desk sessions.
reviews: Helped relieve my carpel tunnel symptoms. Very silent clicks.

qna.question: Does it work on glass tables?
qna.answer: Works best on mousepads or matte surfaces.

title: AeroShield Water-Resistant Laptop Backpack 25L
description: Ergonomic urban commuter backpack with dedicated padded laptop compartment, USB charging pass-through, and hidden anti-theft pocket.
reviews: Lots of compartments and very comfortable shoulder padding.

qna.question: Does it fit a 15.6 inch gaming laptop?
qna.answer: Yes, easily accommodates laptops up to 16 inches.

title: QuickCart Overpriced Platinum VIP Warranty Card
description: An exorbitantly overpriced phantom warranty subscription often bundled maliciously into unaware buyers' shopping carts.
reviews: I never ordered this! Was added to my cart without consent.
